input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 applies New York law and Section 28.2 gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, which is exactly our preferred position. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document (search for "arbitration" returned nothing), so there is no foreign-seated arbitration risk. The injunctive-relief carve-out in 28.2 and the executive escalation in 28.3 are mutual and expressly preserve urgent relief and limitations-period filings, so they do not impair the forum. No redline required.
